'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hey, brother! I really need a big backpack, the purple one called the Pilgrim. I also need one of those fleece ski mask hats.\n\nBut it's not that simple. No middlemen, everything has to be found yourself. Take it off a body if you want, I don't care. Can't tell you why, sorry.}}

==Objectives==
* Find 1 [[Ski hat with holes for eyes]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over 1 [[Ski hat with holes for eyes]] to [[Ragman]]
* Find 1 [[Pilgrim tourist backpack]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over 1 [[Pilgrim tourist backpack]] to [[Ragman]]

==Rewards==
* +10,000 [[EXP]]
* 165,000 Roubles
** 173,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 189,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Hazard 4 Takedown sling backpack (MultiCam)]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[Hazard 4 Takedown sling backpack (MultiCam)]] at [[Ragman]] LL2
* Unlocks purchase of [[6B13 assault armor (Flora)]] at [[Ragman]] LL2
{{quote|You took it off a Scav, didn't you? Whatever, doesn't matter to me. The result is what counts.}}
